entries.zh: 工厂的定制订单需要更长的交付周期。

entries.en: She sedulously copied the faded inscriptions into her notebook.
entries.zh: 她孜孜不倦地把褪色的铭文抄进笔记本。

entries.en: The historian studied the monetization of silver under the old regime.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了旧政权下将白银定为货币的过程。

entries.en: The greenskeeper inspected the course after the heavy rain.
entries.zh: 高尔夫球场管理员在大雨后检查了球场。

entries.en: The library's budget covers a fiscal year beginning in July.
entries.zh: 图书馆的预算涵盖一个从七月开始的财政年度。

entries.en: The messenger approached the gate carrying a flag of truce.
entries.zh: 信使手持休战旗走近大门。

entries.en: The law firm moved into offices beside the courthouse.
entries.zh: 这家律师事务所搬进了法院旁的办公室。

entries.en: The workers dug out the buried pipe before repairing it.
entries.zh: 工人们先挖出埋着的管道，再进行修理。

entries.en: Dark rocks crop out along the shore at low tide.
entries.zh: 低潮时，深色岩石沿海岸露出地面。

entries.en: The standee watched the concert from the back of the hall.
entries.zh: 这位站票观众在大厅后方观看了音乐会。

entries.en: We will reevaluate the route after inspecting the damaged bridge.
entries.zh: 检查受损大桥后，我们将重新评估路线。

entries.en: The conservator cleaned the sgraffito without disturbing its scratched decoration.
entries.zh: 修复师清理了刮画装饰，没有损坏其刮刻图案。

entries.en: Raise the side length to the third power to find the cube's volume.
entries.zh: 把边长取三次幂，就能求出立方体的体积。

entries.en: The witness's account helped the scattered clues fall into place.
entries.zh: 证人的叙述让零散的线索开始有了头绪。

entries.en: The concert featured programme music inspired by mountain landscapes.
entries.zh: 音乐会上演了受山地景观启发的标题音乐。

entries.en: The historical report discusses a change in the Bank of England's base rate.
entries.zh: 这份历史报告讨论了英格兰银行基本利率的一次变动。

entries.en: The student varied the angle of incidence while keeping the mirror fixed.
entries.zh: 学生保持镜子固定，同时改变入射角。

entries.en: We need a backup plan in case the first arrangement does not pan out.
entries.zh: 我们需要一个备选方案，以防最初的安排不能成功。

entries.en: The office will mail out the certificates on Friday.
entries.zh: 办公室将在周五寄出证书。

entries.en: The detective uncovered a bunco involving worthless land certificates.
entries.zh: 侦探揭露了一起涉及无价值土地凭证的骗局。

entries.en: The messenger privily passed the letter to the queen.
entries.zh: 信使暗中把信交给了王后。

entries.en: The coppersmith hammered a shallow bowl from a copper sheet.
entries.zh: 铜匠把一张铜板锤成了一个浅碗。

entries.en: The judge warned the witness about contempt of court.
entries.zh: 法官就藐视法庭问题警告了证人。

entries.en: The archive contains records of early old-age insurance payments.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着早期养老保险付款记录。

entries.en: The operators sorted the cards using off-line equipment.
entries.zh: 操作员用脱机设备给卡片分类。

entries.en: She paused to take a breath before continuing the speech.
entries.zh: 她停下来吸了一口气，再继续演讲。

entries.en: We worked like crazy to finish the mural before the opening.
entries.zh: 我们拼命赶工，争取在开幕前完成壁画。

entries.en: He was the project leader in name only; Maya made every decision.
entries.zh: 他只是名义上的项目负责人，所有决定都是玛雅作的。
